set.body:
Parked on 19 November 2026 (docs/plan.md). A candidate for the first addition after the SHARE5 rehearsal.

Outcome
Labs can see which studies exist at the institute. A steward lists a study; any signed-in member sees its description and can ask for access.

Acceptance
1. A steward can mark a study as listed in the institute catalogue. Listing exposes only the discover-level fields of the catalog record (SEE2) to every active member of the installation: no file names, participants, metadata or counts beyond the record.
2. Home has a Catalogue section, and search includes listed studies, marked as listed with access on request.
3. The study page of a listed study that the caller cannot read shows the description, the custodian and steward names, and an Ask for access action that reaches the steward. An in-app list for the steward is preferred; an email link is acceptable for the MVP.
4. Unlisting removes the study from everyone's catalogue and search at once.
5. Disclosure tests prove that a listed study reveals nothing beyond its record, and that an unlisted study is absent from results, counts and page boundaries.

Design note
This needs an audience wider than one person. Prefer a listing flag on the dataset that the policy evaluates for Discover on the catalog record, not a grant to an invented group. Record the choice in docs/decisions.

Not in scope
External or anonymous visitors. An access-request workflow beyond notify and grant.

Start from
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/OrganizationAuthority.scala lines 195 to 240.
- modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres/DisclosureSuite.scala line 67.

Evidence
Disclosure tests on both catalogs. A browser case with two accounts.
set.title: LATER: Institute catalogue: list a study for everyone signed in, with ask-for-access
